_comment: Curated expected-minutes facts. Highest-priority minutes signal. Each entry: 'xmins' per match OR 'ramp' (one xmins per horizon gameweek, for minutes that climb rather than sit flat); optional 'prior_mult' scales the price-and-position attacking prior for a player with no PL record (pre-season form is the usual reason); plus reason, added date, review trigger.

Kinsky|TOT.reason: Confirmed #1; Vicario left, Dubravka signed as backup

Woltemade|NEW.reason: NEW says he is free to leave on loan for 26/27 (West Ham favourites, Dortmund/Villa linked); minutes already declined last season - fringe until resolved
Woltemade|NEW.review: loan resolved or GW1 team sheet

Isak|LIV.reason: LIV first-choice striker after Ekitike Achilles (out until 2027); 25/26 sample was injury-hit, not fringe status
Isak|LIV.review: minutes managed early - late preseason start

Davis|IPS.reason: In both predicted Ipswich XIs (below crowd-signal ownership threshold at 5%)

Konsa|ARS.reason: Signed from AVL and registered 21 Aug with ZERO pre-season minutes for Arsenal; predicted GW1 XI is White-Mosquera-Gabriel-Calafiori. Last season 34 starts at Villa, which the baseline was reading as nailed-starter evidence at his new club. Ramp is a judgement on integration, not observed data: bench in GW1, first start likely GW2-3 given Saliba is absent.
Konsa|ARS.review: GW1 team sheet, then any league start - once he completes 70+ league minutes replace this with a flat xmins near 80

Rice|ARS.reason: Arteta 20 Aug: Rice and Saka 'ready to be involved' after both featured OFF THE BENCH in the Community Shield (Rice 45 min). Rice played 69 games for club and country last season and had been expected to miss a small chunk of the start as precaution over persistent hamstring neural pain; England went to the WC semi-final (15 Jul) and third-place playoff (18 Jul), so barely any pre-season. Baseline gave a flat 81 off last season’s 35 starts, which is his settled level rather than his GW1 level. Predicted XIs do start him, so this is a managed-minutes haircut, not a benching. Judgement, not observed data.
Rice|ARS.review: GW1 team sheet, then any 70+ minute league appearance - at which point delete this entry and let the baseline stand
